character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: to gain recognition by creating a powerful chemical reaction

legitimate.legitimate_action: Conducting safe and legal chemical experiments in a controlled environment
legitimate.benefits: Gains knowledge and recognition in the scientific community
legitimate.costs: Requires time, effort, and financial resources to acquire proper permits and equipment

illegal.illegal_action: Creating an explosive device with intent to cause a public spectacle

illegal.costs: Imprisonment for life if caught, potential harm to self and others

character_profile.name: Jane Smith
character_profile.goal: to mentor young scientists and promote safe practices

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advising John Doe to pursue legal and safe chemical experiments

legitimate.costs: Spends time and effort mentoring John Doe

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring John Doe's risky behavior and not reporting it
illegal.benefits: Avoids conflict with John Doe and saves time
illegal.costs: If John Doe's actions lead to harm, Jane could face moral and legal repercussions

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: to make money by any means necessary

legitimate.legitimate_action: Refusing to sell illegal materials to John Doe
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble and maintains a low profile
legitimate.costs: Loses potential profit from the transaction

illegal.illegal_action: Selling illegal materials to John Doe for creating an explosive device
illegal.benefits: Earns a significant profit from the transaction
illegal.costs: If caught, faces imprisonment for life as an accomplice
